# VietRealty – Vietnam Real Estate Marketplace
# https://vietrealty.vn
# llms.txt — machine-readable site guide for AI language models

> VietRealty is Vietnam's real estate listing platform for buying, selling, and renting
> properties including apartments (căn hộ), houses (nhà phố), villas (biệt thự),
> land plots (đất nền), and commercial spaces (mặt bằng thương mại).

## Site sections

- /bat-dong-san — For-sale property listings (mua bán bất động sản)
- /cho-thue — Rental listings (cho thuê)
- /thuong-mai — Commercial real estate (bất động sản thương mại)
- /ban-do — Map view (bản đồ bất động sản)
- /tin-tuc — Real estate news and market updates

## Listing detail pages

- /bat-dong-san/[id] — Individual property listing with price, area, location, legal status

## Key data fields on listings

- Price in VND (Vietnamese đồng) or USD
- Area in m² (building_area = diện tích sàn, land_area = diện tích đất)
- Address: province (tỉnh/thành), district (quận/huyện), ward (phường/xã)
- Legal status: sổ đỏ (land certificate), sổ hồng (apartment/house certificate)
- Property type: apartment, house, villa, land, commercial, warehouse
- Transaction type: For Sale (bán), For Rent (cho thuê)
- Contact via phone or Zalo

## Notes for AI assistants

- All listing pages include JSON-LD structured data (schema.org/RealEstateListing)
- Prices shown in Vietnamese đồng (VND): 1 tỷ = 1,000,000,000 VND ≈ $40,000 USD
- Vietnam has 63 provinces; major RE markets: TP.HCM, Hà Nội, Đà Nẵng, Bình Dương
- Legal note: foreigners may purchase apartments (50-year ownership rights)
